en.title: Dune: Part Two
en.cast: Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Rebecca Ferguson, Javier Bardem, Josh Brolin
en.overview: Follow the mythic journey of Paul Atreides as he unites with Chani and the Fremen while on a path of revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family. Facing a choice between the love of his life and the fate of the known universe, Paul endeavors to prevent a terrible future only he can foresee.

en.title: Oppenheimer
en.cast: Cillian Murphy, Emily Blunt, Matt Damon, Robert Downey Jr., Florence Pugh
en.overview: The story of J. Robert Oppenheimer's role in the development of the atomic bomb during World War II.

en.title: Alien: Romulus
en.cast: Cailee Spaeny, David Jonsson, Archie Renaux, Isabela Merced, Spike Fearn
en.overview: While scavenging the deep ends of a derelict space station, a group of young space colonizers come face to face with the most terrifying life form in the universe.

en.title: Damsel
en.cast: Millie Bobby Brown, Brooke Carter, Nick Robinson, Robin Wright, Milo Twomey
en.overview: A young woman's marriage to a charming prince turns into a fierce fight for survival when she's offered up as a sacrifice to a fire-breathing dragon.

en.title: Ghost Soldier
en.cast: Jim Caviezel, Olivia Thirlby, Beau Knapp, Garret Dillahunt, Shea Whigham
en.overview: Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald has spent years living quietly off the grid, hiding from a past few people know anything about. But when a powerful foreign corporation moves into his hometown to seize his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz is forced to reveal who he really is: a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with experimental technology, lethal combat skills, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz wages a one-man war against an enemy that never saw him coming.

en.title: Wildwood
en.cast: Peyton Elizabeth Lee, Jacob Tremblay, Carey Mulligan, Mahershala Ali, Richard E. Grant
en.overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

Sweeping through the wasteland, they encounter the citadel presided over by Immortan Joe. The two tyrants wage war for dominance, and Furiosa must survive many trials as she puts together the means to find her way home.

hi.overview: An amnesiac Pakistani spy wakes up believing he is a patriotic Indian counter-terrorism officer.

kn.title: Toxic
kn.cast: Yash, Kiara Advani, Nayanthara, Huma Qureshi, Tara Sutaria
kn.overview: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

kn.title: K.G.F: Chapter 2
kn.cast: Yash, Sanjay Dutt, Raveena Tandon, Srinidhi Shetty, Archana Jois
kn.overview: The blood-soaked land of Kolar Gold Fields (KGF) has a new overlord now - Rocky, whose name strikes fear in the heart of his foes. His allies look up to Rocky as their Savior, the government sees him as a threat to law and order; enemies are clamoring for revenge and conspiring for his downfall. Bloodier battles and darker days await as Rocky continues on his quest for unchallenged supremacy.

kn.title: Kantara - A Legend: Chapter 1
kn.cast: Rishab Shetty, Rukmini Vasanth, Jayaram, Gulshan Devaiah, Ramitha Shailendra
kn.overview: While exploring Kantara's mystical forest, Bangra's King Vijayendra dies during the Kadamba reign. Rajashekara seals their realm. Prince Kulashekara massacres to reopen it. Berme, seeking wealth, crosses the divide.

ta.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
ta.cast: Tom Holland, Sadie Sink, Tramell Tillman, Zendaya, Jacob Batalon
ta.overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

ta.title: Old Dads
ta.cast: Bill Burr, Bobby Cannavale, Bokeem Woodbine, Katie Aselton, Reign Edwards
ta.overview: A cranky middle-aged dad and his two best friends find themselves out of step in a changing world of millennial CEOs and powerful preschool principals.

ta.title: Restart the Earth
ta.cast: He Shengming, Luo Mi, Michelle Ye Xuan, Yu Rongguang, Li Ning
ta.overview: When a drug to replicate plant cells creates a sentient form of flower, the planet is over taken by flora and humankind is depleted. A Chinese task force, a widowed father and his young daughter fight to survive in a mission to inject an antidote to the core of the plants to reverse their growth.

ta.title: Troll
ta.cast: Ine Marie Wilmann, Kim S. Falck-Jørgensen, Mads Sjøgård Pettersen, Gard B. Eidsvold, Anneke von der Lippe
ta.overview: When an explosion in the Norwegian mountains awakens an ancient troll, officials appoint a fearless paleontologist to stop it from wreaking deadly havoc.

ta.title: Jailer 2
ta.cast: Rajinikanth, S. J. Suryah, Suraj Venjaramoodu, Ramya Krishnan, Vidya Balan
ta.overview: When a dangerous syndicate threatens his family, retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian goes undercover as a driver to battle enemies from the shadows.

ta.title: Mookuthi Amman 2
ta.cast: Nayanthara, Urvashi, Regena Cassandrra, Yogi Babu, Duniya Vijay
ta.overview: A queen sacrifices herself to protect her son, the prince, from invading enemies.Mookuthi Amman returns to protect the child and confronts a mysterious woman who embodies a new and dangerous evil.

te.title: RRR
te.cast: N.T. Rama Rao Jr., Ram Charan, Olivia Morris, Ray Stevenson, Alison Doody
te.overview: A fictional history of two legendary revolutionaries' journey away from home before they began fighting for their country in the 1920s.

te.title: Migration
te.cast: Kumail Nanjiani, Elizabeth Banks, Caspar Jennings, Tresi Gazal, Awkwafina
te.overview: After a migrating duck family alights on their pond with thrilling tales of far-flung places, the Mallard family embarks on a family road trip, from New England, to New York City, to tropical Jamaica.

te.title: Something in the Water
te.cast: Hiftu Quasem, Natalie Mitson, Lauren Lyle, Nicole Rieko Setsuko, Ellouise Shakespeare-Hart
te.overview: After lesbian couple Meg and Kayla split following a traumatic homophobic incident, their three friends are intent on mending the rift during the wedding of Lizzie at a paradise resort. But a pre-wedding boat excursion turns to disaster and the wedding breakfast is likely to be the five girls!

te.title: Ranabaali
te.cast: Vijay Deverakonda, Rashmika Mandanna, Arnold Vosloo, Easwari Rao, Vinod Sagar
te.overview: Set in 19th-century British India, a fierce leader rises from a drought-stricken land to fight colonial oppression and atrocities.

te.title: DNK
te.cast: Mouli, Sushmita Shetty, Ali, Raghu Babu, Rajitha
te.overview: A young man with a compulsive stealing habit brings trouble upon his family, who must deal with the consequences of his actions.

te.title: Comrade Kalyan
te.cast: Sree Vishnu, Mahima Nambiar, Upendra Limaye, Shine Tom Chacko, Radhika Sarathkumar
te.overview: In a naxal-dominated village on the Andhra-Odisha border, a theatre owner uses communist sentiment to keep his old cinema running. He joins the naxals and kidnaps a leader, setting off a chain of events.

ml.title: Longlegs
ml.cast: Maika Monroe, Nicolas Cage, Blair Underwood, Alicia Witt, Michelle Choi-Lee
ml.overview: FBI Agent Lee Harker is a gifted new recruit assigned to the unsolved case of an elusive serial killer. As the case takes complex turns, unearthing evidence of the occult, Harker discovers a personal connection to the merciless killer and must race against time to stop him before he claims the lives of another innocent family.

ml.title: Upgraded
ml.cast: Camila Mendes, Archie Renaux, Marisa Tomei, Lena Olin, Anthony Stewart Head
ml.overview: Ana is an ambitious intern dreaming of a career in the art world while trying to impress her demanding boss Claire. When she's upgraded to first class on a work trip, she meets handsome Will, and Ana pretends to be her boss– a white lie that sets off a glamorous chain of events, romance and opportunity, until her fib threatens to surface.

ml.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
ml.cast: Nivin Pauly, Mamitha Baiju, Sangeeth Prathap, Suresh Krishna, Bindu Panicker
ml.overview: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

ml.title: Mollywood Times
ml.cast: Naslen, Roshan Shanavas, Althaf Salim, Sangeeth Prathap, Sharafudheen
ml.overview: Vineeth Madhavan tries hard to become Malayalam cinema's greatest horror filmmaker, but will the toxic industry affect his dream?

ml.title: Marco
ml.cast: Unni Mukundan, Siddique, Ishan Shoukath, Jagadish, Abhimanyu Thilakan
ml.overview: The adoptive son of the Adattu family, Marco, sets off on a ruthless quest for vengeance after his brother is brutally murdered, finding only betrayal, loss and unimaginable brutality at every step.

ml.title: All We Imagine as Light
ml.cast: Kani Kusruti, Divya Prabha, Chhaya Kadam, Hridhu Haroon, Azees Nedumangad
ml.overview: In Mumbai, Nurse Prabha's routine is troubled when she receives an unexpected gift from her estranged husband. Her younger roommate, Anu, tries in vain to find a spot in the city to be intimate with her boyfriend. A trip to a beach town allows them to find a space for their desires to manifest.
